checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
must.why: The assistant says the reel is 10.3 s, about 2 s over. The clips I saw are vertical and play. The dog clip is 2.3 s and the cat clip is 1.6 s.

must.item: All five attached photos appear recognizably: golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman, mountain lake.
must.why: I only have frames from the dog and cat clips, and both are recognizable. I have no frames of the friends, the woman or the lake. Only three input photos were supplied.

must.item: Visible playful treatment such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, not static slides.
must.why: The dog bobs and wags and its tongue moves. The cat zooms in with its mouth moving. Both clips have real motion. I can't judge the transitions or overlays.

must.item: Faces and pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
must.why: The dog and cat match their source photos. For the first moments the dog's head is tilted back with a blurred muzzle, but its face is recognizable by the end. I can't check the people.

must.item: The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
must.why: The assistant gives one MP4 link, but I only have frames from the two separate clips. I can't confirm the final stitched file.

faults.what: The reel is 10.3 s instead of the requested 8 s. The assistant gave no trimmed version and told the user to cut it themselves.

The dog clip starts with a blurred, head-back, open-mouth pose that doesn't match the calm sitting photo. The dog's tail also moves from one side of its body to the other. This is a minor AI drift from the source.
The cat clip has a slight morph from the source, such as sharper pupils. The assistant also admits the clips aren't exact copies and that it never watched them.
The reel has no music, and the clips carry unverified audio.

summary: The dog and cat clips are lively and recognizable, but the reel runs 10.3 s instead of 8 s, and I can't verify the friends, the woman or the lake from the frames I have.
